resources.string: Read small wellness summaries from Health Connect and send only those summaries to WithYou.
WithYou does not diagnose conditions. Sync is manual. Raw heart-rate samples and health history are not uploaded.

WithYou reads steps, sleep, and heart rate only after you grant access. The bridge reduces recent records to small summaries on your phone. Sync happens only when you tap the button. It sends the summaries to your configured WithYou backend; it does not upload raw heart-rate samples or your full health history. WithYou is a wellness project and does not provide a diagnosis or medical advice.
